title: Sales Advisor
description:
Start date: 02.11.2026

Shift Pattern: Full Time (37.5 hours)

Please note that this position is a full-time role only, and part-time hours are not available.

Sales Advisors

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our Glasgow team's full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Glasgow contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE

GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.

UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.

BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, discounted parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.

GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.

FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.

GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: IFA Client Services Associate
company: Premier Jobs UK Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
A national IFA firm is hiring a Client Service Associate to work remotely across their central region, handling existing client onboarding, review meetings and new business processing. Paying £28,000 to £32,000, this role suits someone who thrives in a structured, task-based environment and wants the flexibility of fully remote working from day one.

Your purpose

You'll be part of their operational thread running through the advice process, ensuring existing clients move smoothly from review through to completion. Working across a central region covering substantial number of clients, you'll handle all the paperwork involved in ongoing cases and new business, picking up work from a centralized task list rather than supporting one dedicated planner. This requires a systematic style of working where accuracy and efficiency matter.

What the job involves
- Processing existing client onboarding across the central region
- Completing all review meeting documentation and follow-up
- Handling new business cases and ongoing client work
- Preparing Letters of Authority and ensuring data accuracy
- Working through structured task lists as cases come in
- Liaising with Financial Advisers and Paraplanners to ensure they have what they need

IFA Client Service Associate Requirements
- Essential: experience in an IFA administration role with strong client onboarding knowledge
- Essential: familiarity with Letters of Authority and the advice process
- Essential: comfortable working in a centralized team across multiple planners
- Desirable: experience using IO, Curo, Cashcalc or Dynamic Planner
- Desirable: based in Scotland, though candidates elsewhere will be considered for this fully remote role

About the business

This growing national firm is led by respected industry names and backed by private equity. On track to exceed £10 billion in assets under management and continuing acquisitions, they recognize that success depends on having the right people.

IFA Client Service Associate Benefits
- Salary of £28,000 to £32,000
- 37.5 hours per week, fully remote
- 28 days holiday plus bank holidays, rising by one day per year to 30 days
- 4x death in service, private medical insurance, group income protection
- Employee assistance programme, Medicash, 8% combined pension contribution
- Discretionary annual bonus

What happens next

Your application comes to Premier Jobs UK, we reply to every candidate either way, and where the experience fits we'll call to understand what you're looking for. Apply now for this remote Client Service Associate role and take the next step in your IFA career.

Liability and disclaimer

Premier Jobs UK Limited is acting as an employment agency for this permanent vacancy. Salary, benefits and on-target earnings are supplied by our client, may change, and form no part of any offer or contract.
